own_solution.law: Vertical motion obeys vy² = (v sin(theta))² - 2g(H - h0). At the apex vy = 0, giving H = h0 + (v sin(theta))²/(2g).

Air resistance is neglected as stated.
Installing the further stand under the platform raises the stated launch height by the stand's height.
The stand used for an earlier experiment only does not support the platform during the present launch.
